current_sprint.name: Spend the Grant, Then Submit
current_sprint.note: Sprint 12 ran across two branches. PR #73 merged the B2/B3 hardware work to develop mid-sprint; PR #75 carries the response to three external reviews (F49-F63) plus F37 and F38, on a branch cut from the Sprint 12 branch per the carry-forward rule. PR #75 merged to develop and PR #76 merged develop to main on 2026-09-11. Issues 71, 72, 57 and 56 closed in the Phase 8.2 sweep; 69 (F48) remains open and returns to the backlog.
